reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; selected separate-reader findings retained in evidence/reviews. No human/Claude acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: Create one short code, follow one redirect, then introduce collision, expiry and delayed cache fill.

scope.evidence: Finished create/redirect/manage architecture has explicit workload assumptions and a stated acceptable stale-redirect interval.

contracts.evidence: Owner-scoped replay fingerprints, immutable create results, unique codes, stored target state and anchored cache permission deadlines agree.

correctness.evidence: ShortenerChecks exercises collision exhaustion, URL validation, 32-way replay, exact expiry, late fill and never reusing codes; capacity numbers remain assumptions.

failure_handling.evidence: Lost create responses replay the same result; late fills cannot restart the read permission budget; revocation is bounded rather than instant.

tradeoffs.evidence: Random codes versus counters/hashes/pools, negative caching, redirect status, sharding and asynchronous analytics have stated consequences.

visual_learning.evidence: Source-generated shortener histories expose collision/replay and cache deadline behavior rather than a decorative service animation.

code.evidence: examples/learning-java/src/kb/shortener; full copyable source/download parity and exact excerpts checked by check_review_lot.py; actual runtime output in lot-command-output.json and lot-runtime.json.

rendering.evidence: HLD-1-browser.json: article and walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px; theme controls, navigation, no missing images/page-wide overflow, table contrast >=4.5. Per-topic assets resolve.

limits: Local mechanism and fixture checks do not establish remote-provider behavior, distributed durability/failover, production throughput or model quality. Scope-specific boundaries are explicit in the answer.
